description: WHEN: a change touched some D365 objects (a pull request, a hotfix) and you need the test cases to replay. Triggers: 'which tests cover SalesLine', 'quels tests rejouer', 'regression tests for PR N', 'couverture de test des objets'. Finds the Test Case work items tagged obj:<object> (the tag ado_create_test_plan adds from `objects`), per object, and lists the objects that no test case covers: those are coverage gaps, not proof that nothing can break. Only cases created with the obj: tags are found; older ones are not. Read only. At most 50 cases.

objects.description: Comma-separated D365 objects, e.g. 'SalesLine, CustInvoiceJour'. Take them from the pull request or find_change_impact.

project.description: Azure DevOps project. Falls back to DEVOPS_PROJECT.

name: ado_find_tests_for_objects
